# Kling 3.0

> > Kling 3.0 is an AI video generation platform featuring physics-based motion control, native audio-visual synchronization, and the Omni One multimodal engine for creating cinema-grade videos from text and images.

Powered by the Omni One engine, Kling 3.0 offers advanced capabilities including Motion Control 3.0 for physics-accurate motion transfer, Kling O3 unified multimodal model, Draft Mode for rapid prototyping, and native audio sync. The platform supports professional workflows with 1080p output, HDR, and integration with tools like DaVinci Resolve and Nuke.

## Key Topics

- Kling 3.0 - Core AI video generation platform
- Omni One - Unified multimodal engine powering video generation
- Kling O3 - 7-in-1 multimodal model with audio sync
- Motion Control 3.0 - Physics-based motion transfer technology
- Draft Mode - 20x faster video prototyping tool
- Text-to-video - Generate videos from text prompts
- Image-to-video - Convert static images to animated videos
- Audio-visual sync - Native audio generation synchronized with video
- Physics engine - Realistic motion and dynamics simulation
- Motion transfer - Extract and apply motion from reference videos
- Character animation - Animate characters with precise control
- Multi Shot - Multiple camera angles and scene composition
- HDR - High dynamic range video output
- 1080p commercial output - Professional-grade video resolution
- Chain-of-Thought - Advanced reasoning for video generation
